data.title: Saudi Toyota Championship Karting 2026 Winners Crowned in Jeddah
data.content:
Jeddah, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The Saudi Toyota Championship Karting 2026 concluded at the Jeddah Corniche Circuit Karting, with champions crowned across several categories, under the supervision of the Saudi Automobile and Motorcycle Federation (SAMF), the event owner, and the management of Bakhashab Motorsports, in partnership with Jameel Motorsport, the official partner.
    A total of 80 competitors qualified for the final rounds after three preliminary stages held in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam, vying for the season’s titles.
    The championship is part of SAMF’s ongoing efforts to develop motorsport in Saudi Arabia, support emerging talent, and refine drivers’ skills through structured competitions that enhance their experience and technical capabilities.
    The federation also continues to strengthen development pathways in karting and establish high safety and organizational standards, helping build a competitive foundation for the growth of motorsport in the Kingdom.
    -- SPA
